theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Cracks in AI Stocks Sink the Once Reliable Carry Trade
top_news.summary: One of Wall Street’s most reliable wagers of 2026 is starting to lose its surefire status.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Rise as Tech Gains in Taiwan, Korea: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks gained as a late recovery on Wall Street brought some stability to markets, following a flight to Treasuries driven by doubts over the artificial intelligence trade.

top_news.title: Copper Rebounds From Lowest This Year as Volatility Grips Metals
top_news.summary: Copper jumped more than 3% from an 11-month low, tracking gains in tech stocks even as doubts lingered over the durability of the AI boom and related industrial metals demand.

top_news.title: Situational Awareness Lost 65% in Wild Third Quarter, WSJ Says
top_news.summary: Situational Awareness told investors it lost 65% after fees in the third quarter, after highly levered bets on artificial intelligence firms nearly led to the hedge fund’s implosion in July, according to the Wall Street Journal.

top_news.title: Australia Capex Surges by Most Since Mining Boom on Data Centers
top_news.summary: Australian business investment surged by the most since the peak of the mining boom in the three months through September, driven by data center-related spending in a bright spot for an otherwise cooling economy.

top_news.title: Gold Edges Lower as US Inflation Data Fuels Bets for Rate Hikes
top_news.summary: Gold edged lower, after rising on Wednesday, as inflation data reinforced bets the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates further.

top_news.title: China 2027 Growth to Top 4.5%, Ex-Official Says
top_news.summary: China’s economy is on track to grow more than 4.5% in 2027, according to former Vice Finance Minister Zhu Guangyao. Speaking to Bloomberg TV’s Avril Hong in Singapore on Wednesday, Zhu noted that Beijing still has room to loosen fiscal policy next year, while also stressing the need for AI regulation. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: How Saks Is Reclaiming Luxury as Exemplar Luxury Group
top_news.summary: Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick reports on how Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly known as Saks Global, is reinventing itself for a fresh start in luxury since emerging from bankruptcy earlier this year. Exemplar Luxury Group CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck, FIT Associate Professor Shawn Grain Carter, Telsey Advisory Group CEO Dana Telsey, and Exemplary Luxury Group President and CCO Darcy Penick share their thoughts. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Dan Loeb’s Third Point Hedge Fund Resumes Private Investments
top_news.summary: Third Point founder Dan Loeb said he’ll resume investing in private companies in his main hedge fund after a prolonged hiatus.

top_news.title: Retail turnarounds are taking hold just in time for the holiday season
top_news.summary: Retail earnings reports on Tuesday pointed to a mix of factors behind the strong results, including a resilient consumer and stronger execution.
